title: Persistent visual change history — automated checks passed
summary: Changes Made shows expanded details on Home. Change History retains every report with timestamps, affected files, status and validation; archive retention and retry checks now pass.

changes.detail: Latest dashboard report opens expanded; complete history remains accessible through Home and More using the existing interface and device persistence.
Append and rebuild refuse to remove bundled reports when source records are missing or edited.
Follow-up labels now use the selected interface language.
Regression tests cover retained archives, restarts, storage errors, immutable source reports, report expansion, statuses, navigation and retry.
First source report initializes the previously empty bundled history. Existing unrelated repository changes are not backfilled with invented dates.
Archive retry resets loading and error state in the retry action instead of synchronously in an effect. Added a provider remount/retry regression test.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: Source reports and bundled manifest matched before this follow-up; the appended manifest will also be checked.

validation.name: Automated regression tests
validation.detail: 6/6 passed: expansion, status labels, preview/history routing with UI mocks, archive retry, provider remount, restart retention, corruption/conflict preservation and append/rebuild protection.

validation.name: Focused lint
validation.detail: ESLint passed for history components, provider, utilities and route. CJS scripts/tests are excluded by repository lint configuration; they were exercised by tests.

validation.name: Native device and live visual preview
validation.detail: No real device or live browser visual verification; no preview link is claimed. No deployment performed.
